sentence: Cohesive teams that share knowledge and a committed workforce widen the performance gain from adoption
passage: [Ullah et al. (2026), p. 1] "cohesive team dynamics enhance collaboration and knowledge sharing" / "a highly committed workforce amplifies the performance benefits of AI adoption by fostering deeper employee engagement, greater adaptability, and enhanced organizational flexibility."

gemini.note: The passage supports that a committed workforce amplifies performance benefits, but it only links cohesive teams to enhanced collaboration and knowledge sharing, not to widened performance gains.
